recipe.build:
VERCODE="$(sed -rn 's/\s*versionCode = (\d)*\s*/\1/p' composeApp/build.gradle.kts)"
cp "fastlane/metadata/android/en-US/changelogs/${VERCODE}.txt" "composeApp/src/androidMain/res/raw/release_notes.txt"
./gradlew assembleIzzy
mv composeApp/build/outputs/apk/izzy/Kreate-izzy.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
